links.note: A worked example on a committed public fixture session, written after the session ran. It demonstrates the record shapes; it is not a preregistration of that run and licenses no claim.

question: On the registered 20-bit prime-order fixture curve, does negation-map BSGS cost more counted group operations (S) than the negation-map rho reference, and what is the rho A/A spread the difference must exceed?

claims.text: Every row recovers the planted scalar (exact computation, verified by the harness).
bsgs.negation costs more S than rho.negation on these two workloads, by more than the rho A/A spread.
claims.if_supported: a descriptive statement about this fixture only; no scaling or speed claim
claims.if_not_supported: the two methods are within the A/A spread on this fixture

hypotheses.statement: On a 20-bit prime-order curve BSGS with the negation map pays its table setup in counted operations and lands above rho.negation in S.
hypotheses.mechanism: BSGS charges sqrt(r)-scale table construction before the first lookup; rho's expected cost is sqrt(pi r / 4) with the negation map.

predictions.minimum_effect: median S of bsgs-neg above the upper end of the rho A/A interval

data_seen.measured: the same session's verified counts; this example is in-sample by construction

arms.description: rho.negation, the reference arm of the smoke spec
rho.negation repeated under a second arm name: the A/A noise floor

positive.not_applicable_reason: every workload carries a planted scalar and the harness checks [k]G = Q on every row; a miss is a wrong_answer row, so detector power is exercised on every run rather than on a separate planted arm

negative.not_applicable_reason: a cost comparison between two methods on the same instances asserts nothing about a null population

factors.name: curve
factors.how: one registered curve from the frozen spec

factors.name: targets
factors.how: the spec's uniform_scalar_sha256_v1 law, independent of arm

factors.name: binary
factors.how: one binary, sha256 pinned, execs /proc/self/exe per child

factors.name: threads
factors.how: RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 in the child environment

factors.name: algorithm_seed
factors.how: drawn per execution by the harness plan, independent of arm

factors.name: arm_order
factors.how: measurement.order alternate: arms interleave within every round

factors.name: host_load
factors.how: steal, PSI, foreign busy ticks recorded per row; affects wall time only

seed_derivation.note: ecbench derives algorithm_seed per execution from the frozen spec's measurement.seed (1) and the plan; every row's seed is in records.jsonl algorithm_seed and in the export

instance_sampling.rule: two targets per curve from target_seed 20261002 under uniform_scalar_sha256_v1

blinding.how: not masked: a three-arm smoke fixture whose arms are named by method in the harness output

power.note: six paired (workload, round) observations per arm; ecbench compare resamples workloads for its interval; a smoke fixture, sized to exercise the pipeline, not to resolve a small effect

primary.name: S
primary.definition: every phase of the method charged in ecbench.gae, setup included, divided by sqrt(r)

primary.name: total GAE
primary.definition: adds + doubles + scalar multiplications charged by the harness over setup, solve and verification

secondary.name: solve wall time
secondary.definition: the harness's solve interval, first target-dependent operation to verified answer

stopping_rules.rule: fixed design: 3 arms x 2 workloads x (1 warmup + 3 rounds) = 24 executions, then stop
a row whose answer does not verify stops nothing and is recorded as wrong_answer

invalidation_rules: a row with outcome.status other than verified is excluded from the decisive comparison and reported
a wall-time value on a row below L2 is descriptive only (wall_valid false); counted units stand at any level

decision_rule.text: C2 is supported when the paired ratio of S (bsgs-neg over rho-neg, summed over the six (workload, round) pairs) has a 95% bootstrap interval excluding 1 and the median difference exceeds the C-aa spread; otherwise within the A/A spread.
decision_rule.threshold: ratio interval excludes 1 and |median difference| > A/A half-width
decision_rule.statistic: sum of S over pairs, ratio candidate/reference (ecbench compare)
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: ratio of summed S, and median S difference in GAE/sqrt(r)

graphs: S per arm per workload with the A/A interval

inadmissible: changing the workloads, seeds, unit or accounting after seeing results
quoting wall time from rows below L2 as a result
reading this fixture as a scaling or speed claim about either method

literature.claim: the counted unit, isolation levels L0-L3 and the paired comparison this protocol uses
